# Q3 Planning Sync — 2026-08-27

## Key Decisions

**Reconciliation revamp — build, not buy. Q3 anchor.**
- Current engine fails on multi-currency batches; 3 incidents this quarter, reconciliation support tickets up 40% QoQ
- Rewrite scoped at ~6 engineer-weeks, includes FX rounding module migration
- Needs Karim (platform) for 2 weeks on ledger integration
- Vendors rejected: Recur $180K/yr; LedgerFlow $140K/yr but can't handle jurisdiction-specific tax codes. Both would still need ~3 engineer-weeks of integration

**Mobile receipt-capture — ship v1 without bulk-select.**
- Prototype tested with 6 users; two findings: users want bulk-select before upload, and OCR confidence indicator needs more prominence
- Bulk-select (~1 sprint) deferred to roadmap as fast-follow — team already stretched by reconciliation

**Vendor payout SLA — not decided, pending analysis.**
- Finance wants 48h payout guarantee post-approval; current p95 is 71h
- Two bottlenecks: manual approval routing (Ops), ACH batching window (Eng)
- Proposed fix: cut batching window 12h → 4h, add second west-coast-shift approver → 48h p95 by mid-Q3
- Cost: ~half sprint eng time, more ACH files/day, added monitoring overhead, SRE sign-off required
- Go/no-go next week: proceed if SRE says monitoring load is manageable; otherwise look at intermediate targets

**Confirmed, no change:**
- Audit-log retention update pushed to Q4 (confirmed with Legal)
- Internal admin-tool refresh stays with intern crew

**Bug-bash burnout** — HR flagged a spike in engineering; Marcus to propose a rotating on-call structure (lightweight proposal, not a big lift)
